skills_versions: Exam name: Fortinet NSE 7 - Secure Networking Architect
Scoring: Pass or fail; Pearson VUE score report
Recommended experience: 3 years networking; 3 years network security; 2 years each hands-on with FortiGate, FortiManager, and FortiAnalyzer
Credential prerequisites: NSE 4 FortiOS plus NSE 5 or NSE 6 Secure Networking, with NSE 7 exam within 2 years of last prerequisite
